card.name: Food and drink exclusions before grapefruit
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as except, containing, and, with, of that come right before the excluded food or drink (grapefruit, purple, alcoholic). Seen in directions on what to mix with or avoid.

modes.label: Except before grapefruit
modes.description: The word except in parentheses after fruit juice, before grapefruit juice.
modes.example: Take capsules with fruit juice (<<except>> grapefruit juice) or water.

modes.label: Linking word in avoid lists
modes.description: And, containing, or of right after avoid or a drink name, before the item to avoid.
modes.example: Avoid food or drink<< containing>> grapefruit during treatment with JOURNAV

modes.label: Color exclusion in clear liquids
modes.description: The word and between red and purple in clear-liquid instructions.
modes.example: Consume only clear liquids; avoid red<< and>> purple liquids.

card.plain: It lights up on the little word just before a food or drink the label says to leave out, like grapefruit juice.
